title: Otis Redding at the Monterey International Pop Festival
artist: Otis Redding with Booker T. & the M.G.'s
release: Filmed by D.A. Pennebaker; Shake! Otis at Monterey (1987)
studio_context: Monterey County Fairgrounds, California, 17 June 1967; the M.G.'s played their own set, then backed Redding.

drum_performances.name: Al Jackson Jr.
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The M.G.'s in front of the rock audience: Shake, Respect, I've Been Loving You Too Long, Satisfaction and Try a Little Tenderness, on film; the likeness is taken from it.
